blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Sara Duterte would face questioning from House prosecutors if her defense lawyers decide to present her as a witness when the Senate impeachment trial resumes on Nov. 9, with the prosecution prepared to confront her over financial records allegedly showing unexplained wealth, undeclared assets and prohibited business interests. House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers welcomed the possibility of Duterte personally answering the remaining impeachment charge, stressing that the prosecution has been preparing for the defense presentation and is ready to scrutinize the explanations she might offer under oath. “Well, kung ipipresenta nila ang […]...
